summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
summary_short.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…

summary_short.zh: free-for-dev 是一个精心整理的 GitHub 资源库，专门为开发者和运维人员解决寻找实用免费云服务的难题。它通过社区协作维护分类列表，收录 SaaS、PaaS 和 IaaS 中提供可持续免费层级的服务，过滤掉短期试用，突出真正可用的选项。你可以直接浏览列表，快速找到用于测试、原型开发或学习的免费工具，如云主机、数据库或监控服务，还能提交遗漏服务，帮助社区共同完善资源。
summary_short.en: free-for-dev is a curated GitHub repository that solves the challenge of discovering genuinely useful free-tier cloud services for developers and DevOps teams. It works by maintaining a community-driven, categorized list of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings with meaningful free tie…
summary_short.es: free-for-dev is a curated GitHub repository that solves the challenge of discovering genuinely useful free-tier cloud services for developers and DevOps teams. It works by maintaining a community-driven, categorized list of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings with meaningful free tie…
